name: merit-aktiva-mcp
description: Your Merit Aktiva bookkeeping in Claude: invoices, payments, reports, ledger and master data (unofficial).
long_description: Every endpoint of the Merit Aktiva API (Estonia) as tools for Claude. Read-only unless you allow writing. Needs a Merit Aktiva company with a PRO or Premium licence and an API key (Merit Aktiva → Seadistused → API seadistus). Unofficial; not affiliated with Merit Tarkvara AS.

merit_api_id.title: API ID
merit_api_id.description: From Merit Aktiva: Seadistused → API seadistus

merit_api_key.title: API key
merit_api_key.description: From Merit Aktiva: Seadistused → API seadistus

company_name.title: Company name (optional)
company_name.description: Whose books these are, e.g. Acme OÜ: Claude sees it, every write must name it (others are refused) and shows it. Useful when another company is connected as its own server (see the README)

ask_company.title: Ask which company
ask_company.description: Claude asks which company a change is for when you have not said. Needs Company name: without it, the extension does not start

allow_write.title: Allow writing
allow_write.description: Let Claude create and change documents in Merit (invoices, payments, cards). Off: read only.

extra_instructions.title: Notes about your company (optional)
extra_instructions.description: Anything Claude should know about how your company does its books
